summary: Aurelion Inc., a Hong Kong-domiciled foreign private issuer (formerly Prestige Wealth Inc.), furnished a Form 6-K disclosing that its board approved the establishment of a Digital Asset Management Committee on November 6, 2026. The committee has two voting members: Chairman Chang-Wei Chiu (chairperson) and CEO Frank Zheng; Chief Accounting Officer Joyce Zheng may attend as a non-voting adviser. It oversees acquisition, holding, custody, deployment and disposal of digital assets within board-set strategy and risk parameters, favoring capital preservation. No transaction terms, pricing, advisors, or ownership changes are stated; the filing is a routine governance disclosure, not a special situation.
